reviews.text:
Zoom Room! I have trained all my dogs now which has been 4 with all success but the only I have now is showing to be a bit more stubborn. The Zoom Room is such an experience! Had my first one on one session. Alex was my trainer she was very very nice. So patient with my dog Blue, and me as I asked the same questions twice. My dog loves to jump on people and pull on the leash-he’s so strong and so sloppy and she wasn’t fazed at all. She has given me “homework” more like fun exercises to do with my dog until our next session. At this place it seems to me that they analyze your dog so to say.
All our dogs are different but also very much alike. They pick up on what makes our dogs tick, and where they might excel and where they need training. So excited to be with Alex and I hope she gives my wild pitbull a chance. Also a shout out to Diego for all his help thus far.

We've been coming here for agility classes for a month now and this is basically my dog's Disneyland. She is always super excited to be in class and have her turn. Super beginner friendly, as we came in with no former agility experience and it was so fun and addictive for the both of us that we attended 8 classes in the span of our first month! We love it here!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this was one of the most disappointing customer service experiences I’ve had.

First, the positive: the instructors at Zoom Room Sherman Oaks are wonderful. They were patient, knowledgeable, and great with my puppy. Unfortunately, management completely changed my perception of this business.

When I first enrolled my 3-month-old puppy, Diego was extremely responsive and accommodating. Looking back, it now feels like that level of care only existed while he was trying to secure the sale.

I purchased a 20-class package and completed about 10 sessions before I was involved in an accident that medically took me out for several months. When I was finally able to return, I was told my remaining classes had “expired.” This was never clearly explained during enrollment, nor was it made obvious on their website.

What bothered me most was the lack of compassion and professionalism afterward. The Culver City corporate location was kind, understanding, and even admitted they didn’t understand why Sherman Oaks wouldn’t make an exception given my medical situation. However, because Sherman Oaks is independently owned, they couldn’t override the decision.

Meanwhile, communication with Diego became increasingly difficult. Calls went unanswered, messages were ignored, and it honestly felt like my number had been blocked. When I finally reached him from another phone, he immediately became dismissive and basically told me to go train somewhere else if I wasn’t happy.

I have been nothing but polite throughout this process and supported this business consistently, including making purchases during nearly every visit. Yet the moment I needed understanding and flexibility after a legitimate accident, I was treated like an inconvenience.

The trainers deserve praise, but management absolutely ruined this experience for me. I would genuinely appreciate the opportunity to speak with the owner because this situation was handled incredibly poorly. Based on my experience, I would strongly caution others before investing significant money at this location.

I enrolled my puppy last April at the Santa Clarita location and was able to attend 3 sessions before receiving an email stating that they’d gone bankrupt. From that point on, I couldn’t get ahold of the owner nor anyone associated with them. I lost over $1,000 that I could not afford to lose, but for the agility training I wanted for my dog. What a scam!
Justin is the trainer guiding me through an exciting agility course for my dog. He's a fantastic instructor, and I've learned so much. This place truly is amazing!
Great staff, great pricing if you book a block of classes rather than paying individually.  I like that you can drop in and out of classes with no commitments to a specific class.

strongly advise against signing up for this dog training service. I paid $2,500 up front at the Santa Clarita location and before I could complete the program, the store went bankrupt and shut down. Now I’ve lost that money with no way to recover it, and I’ve since learned that several similar locations are also closing down. There is no transparency, no accountability, and no protection for clients once they take your payment. Please save yourself the stress and financial loss—do not sign up.

This review is specifically about the owner Diego regarding my experience with him at another location he owns. I have serious concerns regarding the business practices and unprofessional conduct I have experienced at your Thousand Oaks Zoom Room locations under the management of you, the owner, Diego.

I had operational concerns with the Thousand Oaks location. limited class availability and last-minute cancellations made it nearly impossible to provide consistent training for my dog.

When I decided to request a partial refund due to these ongoing issues, I left multiple messages via phone call, voicemail, and text with no response. I was forced to contact my bank to resolve the matter. This led to an extremely concerning interaction with Diego , where he:
•	Threatened to take me to court
•	Threatened to fine me $2,000 if I did not reverse my bank’s decision
•	Displayed hostile behavior and attempted to coerce me into changing my position

I have never experienced such unprofessional and threatening behavior from a business owner. This interaction was particularly distressing and completely inappropriate.

I would strongly encourage you to review Diego’s customer service record and online reviews, as I suspect my experience may not be isolated.

Be better.

I am writing to inform others of our situation it hopes they don't treat you this way. (Specifically Santa Clarita location)

I couldn't be more disappointed with this whole franchise like others we were sold false promises and had to pay almost $2000 upfront. We were promised 39 sessions and still had 27 remaining by the time they closed the doors. What I found extremely disturbing was, one week we are trying to schedule our next session then literally the next week we receive an email that they have closed, supposedly attorneys will be in contact but did not provide attorneys contact information and their email will be deactivated. We attempted to contact our credit card company to reverse charges but unfortunately hit a wall due to a 60 day limitation to dispute charges. We attempted to contact other facilities in hopes of acquiring a corporate number, but no such luck. Overall a horrible business and I would avoid all locations.

I feel compelled to write a second review to reiterate how incredible  and kind Diego and his team are at the Zoom Room Sherman Oaks. The team of Alex and Justin literally took me by the hand and helped me survive Golden Retriever puppyhood with my Daisy. Into the 2nd year of puppyhood I had to have heart surgery as well as breaking my arm and needing surgery on that arm also - when I contacted Diego after over 7 months of not attending classes he welcomed us back with open arms and made sure we got credit for all the unused classes - which had expired at that point - and we were able to jump back into classes again without having to worry. His kindness towards my unexpected medical issues was over the top and so deeply appreciated. They are all a class act at this facility.

Great agility classes with a super trainer.
Quincy loves it
This place is the best. Justin is a phenomenal trainer. So patient and knowledgeable. The whole staff is incredible and I feel incredibly lucky to have found this place!

best investment ever!!!! worth the momey, effort & time. my dog gets better every class
we go.
Was great doing training here when we first got our dog!  Alex is amazing.  The knowledge we got from the classes here became a solid foundation to continue training on our own.
Really enjoyed Justin's training of us as pet owners of our dog Pepsi.   Really dedicated and passionate about training and kept it fun.

My puppy loves the puppy classes and has learned so much from her trainer Justin! We’ve only had a few sessions so far but it’s definitely helped me learn how to work with her and everyone is amazed at how smart she is!

We are so grateful to have found Zoom Room! We have worked with Alex and Diego to get ahead of my puppy's separation anxiety and all the other challenges caring for him requires. I was having some serious puppy blues and working with these thoughtful and skilled trainers have given me the confidence and capability to forge ahead. Your loved ones are in great hands here.

We’ve done a handful of puppy preschool classes and they’ve been great. We really wanted to socialize our puppy right away but the training is also fun. Diego and Alex have also been very helpful and attentive.

This place is clean & hygienic, friendly staff & good trainers.
My puppy is not fully vaccinated yet so they ensure other puppies have at least 2-3 vaccines like ours to ensure safety, so she can socialise under a "safer" environment.

They have small bred classes - agility and obedience which is great.  We were able to get her to do "stay" after one lesson, which I struggled to do by myself even after watching YT.  haha

Definitely recommend puppy playground for shy and active dogs alike.
I've been taking our pup here for about a month now and it's great for socializing him and learning a few different tactics make him more obedient. Looking forward to more classes
